reason: Stock WebKit reports no service workers (workers.service is unsupported), so a page's service worker and its controller change aren't observed; the matrix row says Strider has service workers without a WebKit override
A frame's localStorage is read in Strider's isolated world, and stock WebKit has no isolated worlds (isolatedWorlds is unsupported)
Strider's storage state has no origin-private file (OPFS) export or import, so the test's OPFS entries can't be read or restored
Strider's storage state carries no WebAuthn credentials, and a context has no credentials collection: its virtual authenticator is per page

Playwright reads a storage state from a file path and names the path in its read error. Strider's state is a decoded value and reads no file: a caller reads the file and decodes it with StorageState.Json, so the path error has no Strider counterpart
